q: Does a Chandrapur ferro alloy plant face CBAM on its exports?
title: Chandrapur ferro alloys: CBAM check
short: Only for alloys on the CBAM list. Ferro-manganese, ferro-chromium and ferro-nickel are covered; silico-manganese and ferro-silicon are not. For covered alloys, send direct emissions from coke, coal and electrodes per tonne, worked out by mass balance.
audience: Ferro alloy plants in Chandrapur and Vidarbha selling to EU steel mills or traders

p: Carbon in coke, coal and electrode paste in, minus carbon out in alloy and slag, times 44/12. Divide by tonnes of alloy.
Furnace electricity is reported but not charged. With India's grid at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 on CEA v21.0, buyers will still notice it.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.
